items.title: Guardant Health (GH) Could Be 17% Undervalued As Board Appointment Tests Valuation
items.summary: Guardant Health (GH) has drawn fresh attention after appointing Kevin Sayer, former Dexcom CEO and current Executive Chairman, to its board of directors. The move is raising new questions about where the stock’s story goes next. items.title: Will Shield Award Recognition Change Guardant Health Stock Narrative
items.summary: Guardant Health reported that its Shield blood test for colorectal cancer screening received the 2026 Prix Galien USA Award for Best Medical Technology, recognizing the first FDA approved blood test for primary colorectal cancer screening and its role in raising screening participation and adherence in real world use. The company also added Kevin Sayer, former Dexcom CEO and current Executive Chairman, to its board. This brings deep digital health operating experience and governance insight...

items.title: DexCom to Launch 15-Day G7 CGM System in Canada This November
items.summary: DXCM's upcoming Canadian launch of the G7 15 Day CGM, offering longer sensor wear and improved convenience, could boost international growth and patient access.

items.title: 3 quality compounders with promising prospects
items.summary: A quality compounder is a business that not only sports durable competitive advantages but also builds on its success by consistently reinvesting its profits at high returns.

items.title: Abbott, Dexcom grapple with diabetes coverage ahead of planned Medicare expansion
items.summary: Abbott said it is facing pricing pressure and slower growth ahead of a planned coverage expansion for people with Type 2 diabetes. Competitor Dexcom, however, did not experience the same slowdown.

items.title: Dexcom lifts 2026 revenue outlook after positive Q3
items.summary: Dexcom now expects 2026 revenues to land in the $5.2bn to $5.25bn range, up from $5.18bn at the low-end as previously outlined.

items.title: DXCM Q3 deep dive: clinical momentum and new product launches support growth trajectory
items.summary: Medical device company DexCom (NASDAQ:DXCM) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 11.2% year on year to $1.34 billion. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $5.23 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.73 per share was 8.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: DexCom (DXCM) Stock Looks Below Fair Value on Cash Flow
items.summary: DexCom has enjoyed a strong run over the past year, yet the share price still leaves a basic question on the table for investors who care about cash flows. With the stock now trading around US$82.29, the issue is whether the underlying stream of future cash the business can produce really lines up with that tag.
